name: dense_orig
notes: Improvement over the dense baseline: only change is first_search=original (system searches the original question verbatim first; counts toward max_searches=3). Hypothesis: Dev errors d01, d11: the original question ranks the gold chunk #1/#3 with dense, but the agent only searched its own rewrites, which lost it. Searching the original question first should put the evidence in context (dense Context Evidence 13/15 -> 15/15) and fix d01, d11.
